# Set the image scale and bias for input image preprocessing.
mean = np.array((0.485, 0.456, 0.406))
std = np.array((0.229, 0.224, 0.225))

import coremltools as ct
scale = 1.0 / (0.226 * 255.0)
bias = -mean / std

image_input = ct.ImageType(
    name="x",
